title: PostIntegratedSummaryResult
description: Schema for the per-post full-text summary produced by the fixed AUTO-008 summary prompt. post_id and source_url are attached by the program, not the model. Citations must reference only text_block_id or image_id values present in the actual input; image_id=null is never a valid reference.

summary.description: Coherent full-text summary of the post.

key_points.description: Primary points only; may be empty.

text_block_ids.description: References to actual input text_block_id values; empty if unused.

image_ids.description: References to actual input image_id values; empty if unused. image_id=null is not a valid reference.

basis.description: Whether the point rests on post text, image summary, or both.

uncertainties.description: Important conflicts or unverifiable claims; may be empty.

issue.description: An important conflict or piece of information that cannot be confirmed.

text_block_ids.description: References to actual input text_block_id values; empty if unused.

image_ids.description: References to actual input image_id values; empty if unused.
